finding_2_the_roll_release_is_a_LEVEL_ef.statement: A multi-session index/calendar roll does not merely contribute negative net flow to the front leg while it runs - it holds a DEPRESSION in the level for the duration of the program. The terminal session is therefore not 'the same sign, smaller'; it is where the depression is RELEASED. Sizing the terminal day off the residual tranche is a category error: the residual tranche is the flow, the accumulated depression is the price.
finding_2_the_roll_release_is_a_LEVEL_ef.this_is_the_root_cause_of_my_wrong_sign: My blind derivation was structurally correct right up to its last step. I established that 0611 stacked THREE down-generators (GSCI terminal tranche, BCOM day 4, a bearish realized EIA print), that two of the three expire at the 0611 close, and that only BCOM's fifth-of-five survives into 0612. From that I wrote 'the sign carries and the size collapses.' Removing the dominant seller from a market does not make the market fall by less. It makes it rise.
finding_2_the_roll_release_is_a_LEVEL_ef.measured_on_G21: The front leg was ABSORBING the roll sell for the whole window, and the refine shows it plainly: 0609 sflow -1,704 -> day +70; 0610 sflow -1,813, absorb_session TRUE -> day +490. Sustained mechanical selling was being taken and price went UP anyway. The single session that broke through (0611, -1,080) is the one where a bearish print landed on top - and its low is stamped at 10:30:01 ET, the print minute exactly. Then the terminal day 0612: +620, closing at 0.98 of its range. The three sessions after the roll ends run 3.079 -> 3.254 = +1,750, recovering more than the entire window's decline.
finding_2_the_roll_release_is_a_LEVEL_ef.the_visible_tell_and_why_it_is_the_discr: The brain's own incumbent contains a COUNTEREXAMPLE I must answer: daytype.friday_exit_decomposition cites 0213 as 'the roll's last marked day, undersized -1400' - a roll-terminal day that went DOWN and went down harder than called. So the release does NOT fire on every terminal day, and I will not propose that it does. The candidate discriminator is whether the counterparty's accumulation is VISIBLE on the front leg: on 0612 the roll's spread counterparty was showing as a size-weighted big_print_b_share of 0.572 on 160 prints (big_prints_n 108 -> 160, +48%, on the terminal GSCI day), i.e. the long inventory that becomes supply-free the moment the seller stops. FALSIFIABLE FORM: on a roll-terminal session with an elevated front-leg big-print BID share, expect RELEASE-UP; without one, expect continuation-DOWN (the 0213 class). n=1 for the up arm, n=1 (borrowed, unverified) for the down arm. Offered as a mechanism with a stated counterexample and a discriminator, NOT as a play.
finding_2_the_roll_release_is_a_LEVEL_ef.why_this_does_not_resurrect_a_refuted_ar: flow.price_free_absorption_proxy's mirror arm (big prints under a NEGATIVE session tape) is refuted in the brain on four G20 counterexamples, and I add a fifth below - it stays refuted. The claim here is strictly CONDITIONAL on being inside an index-roll window on the front leg, and I checked that the refuting sample does not touch it: G20's 0527/0528 are business days 18-19 of May and 0603/0604 are business days 3-4 of June, so none of the four sits in a bd5-bd9 index-roll window. The general channel carries no information; the roll-window channel is a different, mechanically-named object.

finding_3_two_incumbents_contradicted_ea.incumbent_B_HIT: direction.flow_conviction_sign_gate, D's r2 final-phase arm: an ALIGNED final phase delivers a NEGATIVE-to-flat next terminal leg. 0612 ph3 = signed flow +2,865 under price +460 = ALIGNED, on 37,156 lots (the session's largest phase). It predicts a negative-to-flat seam leg. Realized: gap -750, and 0615's own ph1 came -93 flow / -140 px. Negative on both readings of 'terminal leg'. The arm goes 5-for-5 and it is the first ALIGNED-POSITIVE final phase it has been tested on - D's four exemplars are all negative-flow phases, so this extends its coverage rather than merely repeating it.
finding_3_two_incumbents_contradicted_ea.the_precise_hit_on_the_seam_play_text: The seam play asserts that 'the D-1 close-exit delivery-vs-absorption read is ORTHOGONAL to the seam sign (it governs intraday continuation, not the gap).' G21 says the two channels are SWAPPED: the delivery-vs-absorption read governed the GAP (-750, called), and the crowded-short covering governed the INTRADAY (0615 session net +910, absorb_session TRUE, ph3 -1,451 absorbed under +520 = textbook covering; 0616 followed +970). finding_3_two_incumbents_contradicted_ea.restatement_offered: A worsening-COT crowded short at a seam arms an UP SESSION at the first post-seam session, not an UP GAP. The gap is priced by the exit session's final-phase conviction. n=1 seam out-of-block; this is a scored head-to-head between two PRE-EXISTING incumbents on one boundary, explicitly post-hoc adjudication and not a new derivation.
finding_3_two_incumbents_contradicted_ea.corroborating_but_weaker: Both weekend seams touching this block gapped DOWN in a regime the play calls base-case UP: -350 into 0608 and -750 into 0615. Meanwhile the eight intraweek boundaries gapped 0, -10, 0, 0, +10, -10, -10, 0 - i.e. essentially zero. In G21 the ONLY material gaps in the record are the two weekend seams and both went against the positioning prior. n=2, one block.

finding_4_my_own_two_G20_plays_run_prope.measurement_note_on_the_phase_grid: Phases are wall-clock THIRDS of the session span, not fixed clock windows (group_mbo_engine.per_day_evidence). 0612 spans 1,259.5 min (20:00 Thu -> 17:00 Fri), so its thirds are 20:00-03:00 / 03:00-10:00 / 10:00-17:00, against roughly 17:00-01:00 / 01:00-09:00 / 09:00-17:00 on a full 1,440-min day. Within a day the thirds are equal-duration, so limb (b)'s volume comparison is sound as written. But on a SHORT session limb (a)'s ph3/ph2 net ratio compares a US-day phase against a mostly-European phase, where on a full session it compares two overlapping phases - so the ratio is not commensurable across session lengths. Flagged for whoever next tunes the 5% bar; it does not change any verdict here.

magnitude_derivation.principle: Three independent routes, each anchored on measurable state, converged before any of them was compared to the actual. The realized +620 is NOT the target; the routes are.
magnitude_derivation.route_a_absorber_capacity_floor: 0610 is the block's clean roll-only session with no print: it absorbed -1,813 of mechanical sell and still delivered +490 (absorb_session TRUE). That is the demonstrated capacity of the bid that was standing under this leg through the whole window. On 0612 the mechanical sell is on its last of five tranches and the same bid turns aggressor. +490 is a FLOOR, not an estimate.
magnitude_derivation.route_b_print_extension_retrace: 0611 fell -1,080 with a -1,330 excursion whose low is stamped at 10:30:01, the print minute, and closed 0.17 off that low. The print is behind and the next is six sessions out. A next-session retrace of a print-driven extension at ~50% of the day-move gives +540.
magnitude_derivation.route_c_aligned_final_phase_band: direction.flow_conviction_sign_gate: an ALIGNED phase DELIVERS THE BAND in the flow direction. The regime band is n0_net_sigma_20 = 862 (0605 vintage, documented ~53% low on net sigma, so this is a conservative denominator) and sigma_5 1,117. A close-on-high aligned-conviction day sits at 0.6-0.7 sigma_20 = +520 to +600.
magnitude_derivation.convergence: +490 / +540 / +520-600. The number is +540 = 0.63x n0_net_sigma_20 and 0.48x sigma_5.
magnitude_derivation.what_is_deliberately_NOT_claimed: The session high is stamped at 16:59:12 ET - the final minute - and high_late is TRUE. The last leg into the bell is weekend short-squaring against a COT that printed a new one-year short extreme at 15:30 the same afternoon. That is a reactive tail on my own day and per doctrine it is not mine to claim. +540 sits 80 under the realized +620 for exactly that reason, and I would emit +540 again.
magnitude_derivation.band_asymmetry: [+200, +1,000]. The lower shoulder is real: the -480 morning excursion happened, and a failure to hold the 07:27 turn leaves a small day rather than a big one. The upper shoulder reaches +1,000 because 0615 went on to deliver +910 of session net on the same mechanism - the release had more in it than one session.
magnitude_derivation.range_vs_net: Realized range 1,120 (high +640, low -480) against n0_range_20_mean 1,266. Per daytype.thin_session_range_invariance the shorter Friday session compressed the clock, not the range - 0.88x on a span that is 87% of a full session. The p50 curve carries a genuine -350 excursion under a +540 close for that reason.

Anchored on the measured phase grid (thirds of a 1,259.5-min span: ph1 20:00-03:00 flat at +210 flow / 0 px; ph2 03:00-10:00 carrying the -480 low at 07:27 but ending +170; ph3 10:00-17:00 delivering +460 on +2,865 of buy flow). days.confidence_reasoning: The sign is carried by two independent measured gates that do not share an input - ph2 absorption (negative flow under rising price = reversal in the price direction, direction.absorption_is_reversal) and ph3 aligned conviction (direction.flow_conviction_sign_gate) - and confirmed by a close at 0.98 of range. That part is near-certain. The 0.84 rather than 0.9 is the magnitude: three routes converge tightly but all three rest on a single block's worth of roll-window sessions, and the roll-release mechanism has a live counterexample in the brain's own record (0213).

weight_assigned.note: The blind AS EMITTED gets 0.30 because it was wrong-signed and the sign is the whole day. But its structural content is not what failed: the calendar frame (terminal tranche, generator inventory, expiry distances), the roll-pre-pricing read off contract_structure, and the big-print observation itself are all retained and are the MECHANISM behind the corrected call. What the causal evidence supplied is the CONSEQUENCE - that a removed dominant seller releases a level rather than shrinking a decline - plus the magnitude routes, which use price. A correctly-reasoned blind would have carried roughly 0.55 here; the emitted one earns 0.30.

My blind established the right mechanism - two of three down-generators expire at the 0611 close - and drew the one wrong conclusion available from it. summary.the_stand_down_verdict: TWO-PART, and only one part was wrong. The SCOPE argument was correct and stays correct: flow.price_free_absorption_proxy is positive-flow-only and its mirror arm is refuted - 0611 adds a fifth datapoint (.572 under -3,772 -> +620) that keeps it refuted at two up and two down. The CONTAMINATION argument was factually right and consequentially backwards: the big-print bid almost certainly WAS the index roll's spread counterparty, and I used that to zero the reading out. A roll counterparty's front-leg accumulation is a REAL LONG that becomes supply-free the instant the mechanical seller expires. Contaminated is not the same as uninformative. That is the error, and it is a different error from the one it looks like.
